spine.zh: 标普六连跌与金价续跌

influence.en: Wallstreetcn breakfast (20 November). Thursday closes for US, China, and Hong Kong stocks, the COMEX gold contract, WTI and Brent, the dollar index, and offshore yuan at 6.6999.
influence.zh: 华尔街见闻早餐（11月20日）。周四美股、A股和港股收盘、COMEX黄金、WTI和布伦特、美元指数，以及离岸人民币6.6999。

influence.en: Wallstreetcn (20 November). Nvidia at 145.98, AMD at 489.19, and Anthropic's close at 97.17. The session low in gold was the lowest since September 2025.
influence.zh: 华尔街见闻（11月20日）。英伟达145.98美元，AMD 489.19美元，Anthropic收于97.17美元。黄金盘中低点为2025年9月以来最低。

influence.en: Yicai (20 November). The same Dow, S&P 500, and Nasdaq closes: 49097.06, 7175.83, and 23879.20.
Yicai (19 November). Shanghai 3577.62, Shenzhen 10583.20, ChiNext 2293.34, STAR50 1270.78, and turnover of 1.31 trillion yuan.
Xinhua (20 November). December WTI settled at 83.21 dollars, down 0.06%, and January Brent settled at 91.98 dollars, up 0.03%.
influence.zh: 新华社（11月20日）。12月WTI收于83.21美元，下跌0.06%；1月布伦特收于91.98美元，上涨0.03%。

influence.en: Xinhua (19 November). The Hang Seng closed at 22841.62, down 1.95%. Hang Seng Tech closed at 3649.14, down 2.33%. Tencent closed at 348.4 Hong Kong dollars, down 6.55%.
US Treasury curve for 19 November. The 2-year yield is 4.76%, the 10-year is 5.04%, and the 30-year is 5.40%. On 18 November they were 4.80%, 5.07%, and 5.41%.
Caixin (20 November). Xi's four points on how major powers should deal with each other, and the line that a nuclear war cannot be won and must not be fought.
influence.zh: 财新（11月20日）。习近平关于大国如何相处的四点看法，以及核战争打不赢也打不得。

influence.en: BlockBeats (20 November). Chicago Fed president Goolsbee said a larger-than-usual increase is not ruled out.
influence.zh: 律动（11月20日）。芝加哥联储行长古尔斯比说，不排除幅度大于通常水平的加息。

influence.en: CICC (15 November). The dollar's rise has come from the shift in officials' tone, and a 50 basis point step was not yet in the price.
influence.zh: 中金（11月15日）。美元走强来自官员态度的转变，50个基点的加息还没有计入价格。

influence.en: Glassnode (17 November). Realized losses reached a level seen only near past cycle lows.
influence.zh: Glassnode（11月17日）。已实现亏损达到过去只在周期低点附近出现过的水平。

influence.en: 20 November 财经早茶. Anthropic's debut, the Hormuz risk, Alibaba's own chips, and the Hong Kong dollar-bond sale.
influence.zh: 11月20日财经早茶。Anthropic首秀、霍尔木兹风险、阿里巴巴的自研芯片，以及在香港发行的美元主权债。

title.en: Approved earlier-generation chip sales cluster in two firms
title.zh: 较早一代芯片的获批销售集中在两家公司

analysis.en: The Tencent bar runs past the 140 mark, counted in thousands. The Alibaba bar ends between the 60 and 80 marks. The Baidu bar ends just past the 40 mark. The BYD bar is a short mark beside the axis. Tencent and Alibaba hold most of the licensed amount in the figure, so those two firms account for the bulk of this approved supply.
analysis.zh: 腾讯的柱越过刻度140，单位是千枚。阿里巴巴的柱落在60到80之间。百度的柱刚过40。比亚迪的柱是零轴旁边的短柱。腾讯和阿里巴巴占了图中大部分许可数量，获批供应集中在这两家公司。

marketTone.en: US stocks fell hard, and the S&P 500 dropped for a sixth day. Anthropic rose on its first day, and gold fell for a fourth day.
marketTone.zh: 美股大跌，标普500连续第六日下跌。Anthropic上市首日上涨，黄金连续第四日下跌。

text.en: The Dow fell 2.19% to 49097.06, the S&P 500 fell 2.02% to 7175.83, a sixth straight drop, and the Nasdaq fell 2.25% to 23879.20, 华尔街见闻 and 第一财经 reported.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻、第一财经：道指下跌2.19%至49097.06，标普500下跌2.02%至7175.83，为连续第六日下跌，纳斯达克下跌2.25%至23879.20。

text.en: The US Treasury 2-year yield is 4.76%, the 10-year is 5.04%, and the 30-year is 5.40%. On 18 November they were 4.80%, 5.07%, and 5.41%.

December WTI fell 0.06% to 83.21 dollars and January Brent rose 0.03% to 91.98 dollars, Xinhua and 华尔街见闻 reported. The Market snapshot Brent row is the Yahoo BZ=F quote, a different quote from this January price.
text.zh: 新华社、华尔街见闻：12月WTI下跌0.06%至83.21美元，1月布伦特上涨0.03%至91.98美元。行情快照的布伦特一行是Yahoo的BZ=F报价，和这一1月价格不是同一报价。

text.en: The COMEX continuous gold contract fell 2.16% to 3660.9 dollars an ounce, and spot gold fell 1.70% to 3661.51 dollars, 华尔街见闻 reported. The Market snapshot gold row is the Yahoo futures quote, a different quote from these prices.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：COMEX当月连续合约下跌2.16%至每盎司3660.9美元，现货黄金下跌1.70%至3661.51美元。行情快照的黄金一行是Yahoo期货报价，和这两个价格不是同一报价。

text.en: Shanghai fell 0.28% to 3577.62, Shenzhen fell 0.71% to 10583.20, and the ChiNext index fell 0.79% to 2293.34. STAR50 rose 1.83% to 1270.78. Turnover was 1.31 trillion yuan, a low for the year, 第一财经 and 华尔街见闻 reported.
text.zh: 第一财经、华尔街见闻：上证下跌0.28%至3577.62，深证成指下跌0.71%至10583.20，创业板指下跌0.79%至2293.34。科创50上涨1.83%至1270.78。成交1.31万亿元，创年内新低。

text.en: The Hang Seng fell 1.95% to 22841.62, and the Hang Seng Tech index fell 2.33% to 3649.14. Tencent fell 6.55% to 348.4 Hong Kong dollars, Xinhua reported. Main-board turnover was 229.549 billion Hong Kong dollars.
text.zh: 新华社：恒生指数下跌1.95%至22841.62，恒生科技指数下跌2.33%至3649.14。腾讯下跌6.55%至348.4港元。主板成交2295.49亿港元。

text.en: The Nikkei 225 rose 0.71% to 59444.21, and the Kospi rose 1.39% to 5137.89, 华尔街见闻 reported. Those are the completed Thursday closes.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：日经225上涨0.71%至59444.21，韩国综指上涨1.39%至5137.89。这是周四已经完成的收盘。

text.en: The dollar index rose to 103.895, the highest since April 2025. Offshore yuan weakened to 6.6999 per dollar in the session, the weakest since mid-October, 华尔街见闻 reported. The Market snapshot USD/CNY row is the Yahoo quote, a different quote from this offshore price.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：美元指数升至103.895，为2025年4月以来最高。离岸人民币盘中走弱至1美元兑6.6999，为10月中旬以来最弱。行情快照的美元兑人民币一行是Yahoo报价，和这一离岸价格不是同一报价。

text.en: LME three-month copper fell 0.14% to 12453 dollars a tonne, 华尔街见闻 reported.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：LME三个月期铜下跌0.14%至每吨12453美元。

signal.en: The S&P 500 fell 2.02% to 7175.83, a sixth straight drop, and the Nasdaq fell 2.25% to 23879.20. The 10-year Treasury yield is 5.04%, down from 5.07% on 18 November. December WTI fell 0.06% to 83.21 dollars, and the COMEX continuous gold contract fell 2.16% to 3660.9 dollars.
signal.zh: 标普500下跌2.02%至7175.83，连续第六日下跌，纳斯达克下跌2.25%至23879.20。10年期国债收益率报5.04%，11月18日为5.07%。12月WTI下跌0.06%至83.21美元。COMEX当月连续黄金合约下跌2.16%至3660.9美元。

watch.en: UK retail sales are at 15:00 Beijing. The Hang Seng index review is due after the cash close. ECB president Lagarde speaks at 16:30. Fed governor Waller speaks at 21:25. The University of Michigan sentiment final is at 23:00.
watch.zh: 英国零售销售在北京时间15:00。恒生指数检讨在收市后公布。欧洲央行行长拉加德在16:30讲话。美联储理事沃勒在21:25讲话。密歇根大学消费者信心终值在23:00。

title.en: The S&P 500 fell for a sixth day as Anthropic opened higher

fact.en: The Dow fell 2.19% to 49097.06, the S&P 500 fell 2.02% to 7175.83, a sixth straight drop, and the Nasdaq fell 2.25% to 23879.20, 华尔街见闻 and 第一财经 reported. Nvidia fell 3.30% to 145.98, a sixth down day, the Philadelphia semiconductor index fell 2.41%, and AMD closed down 7.72% at 489.19, 华尔街见闻 reported. Anthropic opened at 111.50 dollars, up 34.3% from the 83 dollar price, and closed at 97.17 dollars, up 17.1%, with a market value of 1.27 trillion dollars, 华尔街见闻 reported.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻、第一财经：道指下跌2.19%至49097.06，标普500下跌2.02%至7175.83，连续第六日下跌，纳斯达克下跌2.25%至23879.20。华尔街见闻：英伟达下跌3.30%至145.98，为连续第六日下跌，费城半导体指数下跌2.41%，AMD收跌7.72%至489.19。华尔街见闻：Anthropic开盘111.50美元，较83美元的发行价上涨34.3%，收于97.17美元，上涨17.1%，市值1.27万亿美元。

mechanism.en: The indexes fell to the day's lows as the new shares opened, so a higher first print did not lift chip shares. 财经早茶 (20 November): the steady debut failed to restore confidence in the AI trade, and the S&P 500 fell for a sixth day. US stocks fell, and the new shares still closed up 17.1%.
mechanism.zh: 新股开盘时，指数落到了当天的低点，所以更高的开盘价没有带起芯片股。财经早茶（11月20日）：稳健的首秀没有恢复市场对人工智能交易的信心，标普500连续第六日下跌。美股下跌了，新股仍然收涨17.1%。

title.en: Yields fell again while a larger hike stayed open
title.zh: 收益率再降，更大幅度的加息仍留着

fact.en: The US Treasury 2-year yield is 4.76%, the 10-year is 5.04%, and the 30-year is 5.40%. On 18 November they were 4.80%, 5.07%, and 5.41%. The dollar index rose to 103.895, the highest since April 2025, and Chicago Fed president Goolsbee said a larger-than-usual increase is still an option, 华尔街见闻 and 律动 reported.
fact.zh: 美国财政部：2年期收益率4.76%，10年期5.04%，30年期5.40%。11月18日分别为4.80%、5.07%和5.41%。华尔街见闻、律动：美元指数升至103.895，为2025年4月以来最高。芝加哥联储行长古尔斯比说，更大幅度的加息仍是选项。

mechanism.en: Yields fell again on a day when a larger increase was left open, so the tighter talk showed up in the dollar. CICC (15 November): the dollar's rise has come from the shift in officials' tone, and a step of 50 basis points was not yet in the price. The 10-year yield fell to 5.04%, and the dollar rose to 103.895.
mechanism.zh: 更大幅度的加息还留在选项里的这一天，收益率又降了，更紧的说法体现在美元上。中金（11月15日）：美元走强来自官员态度的转变，50个基点那一步还没有计入价格。10年期收益率降到了5.04%，美元升到了103.895。

title.en: Gold fell for a fourth day and stayed at a September 2025 low
title.zh: 黄金连跌第四天，仍在2025年9月的低位

fact.en: The COMEX continuous gold contract fell 2.16% to 3660.9 dollars an ounce, and spot gold fell 1.70% to 3661.51 dollars, 华尔街见闻 reported. Gold fell for a fourth straight day, 财经早茶 reported. The session low was the lowest since September 2025, 华尔街见闻 reported.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：COMEX当月连续合约下跌2.16%至每盎司3660.9美元，现货黄金下跌1.70%至3661.51美元。财经早茶：黄金连续第四日下跌。华尔街见闻：盘中低点为2025年9月以来最低。

mechanism.en: A fourth down day extended the low since September 2025, on a session when hike talk got louder and the dollar rose. Jefferies (20 November): similar macro periods have left gold weak, though the latest comparable case later rose. Gold is the market that fell.
mechanism.zh: 连续第四日下跌，把2025年9月以来的低点又往下带了一步，当天加息的说法更响，美元也在升。杰富瑞（11月20日）：类似的宏观组合里黄金偏弱，不过最近一个可比时期后来出现了上涨。黄金是下跌的那个市场。

title.en: Crude settled almost flat after an intraday Hormuz jump
title.zh: 霍尔木兹盘中推高油价，结算几乎走平

fact.en: December WTI fell 0.06% to 83.21 dollars a barrel, and January Brent rose 0.03% to 91.98 dollars, Xinhua and 华尔街见闻 reported. Prices jumped after tankers hit mines in the Strait of Hormuz, and the settle gave that jump back, 华尔街见闻 reported. Attacks on tankers in the strait have increased since October, and Western officials see a higher chance of a new large US strike, though no decision has been made, 财经早茶 reported.
fact.zh: 新华社、华尔街见闻：12月WTI下跌0.06%至每桶83.21美元，1月布伦特上涨0.03%至91.98美元。华尔街见闻：霍尔木兹海峡油轮触雷后价格跳升，结算时涨幅回吐。财经早茶：10月以来，对海峡油轮的袭击明显增多。西方官员认为美国发动新一轮大规模打击的可能性上升，但还没有最终决定。

mechanism.en: The closing prices were almost unchanged after the intraday jump, so the higher strike risk did not stay in the settle. 财经早茶 (20 November): crude was roughly flat even as worry grew that the Middle East conflict would escalate again. December WTI closed at 83.21 dollars.
mechanism.zh: 盘中跳升之后，收盘价几乎没变，所以更高的打击风险没有留在结算价里。财经早茶（11月20日）：尽管担忧中东冲突会再次升级，原油大致持平。12月WTI收在83.21美元。

title.en: London copper steadied while the China import premium hit a record
title.zh: 伦铜企稳，中国进口溢价创纪录

fact.en: LME three-month copper fell 0.14% to 12453 dollars a tonne, steadying after the prior session's drop, 华尔街见闻 reported. The Yangshan import premium more than doubled in the past week to a record, and traders started moving copper from the US to China, 财经早茶 reported.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：LME三个月期铜下跌0.14%至每吨12453美元，在前一日下跌之后企稳。财经早茶：洋山进口铜溢价过去一周上涨逾一倍，创下纪录，交易商开始把美国的铜运往中国。

mechanism.en: Futures only steadied, while the China import premium jumped to a record, so the tight spot market and the futures price pulled apart. 财经早茶 (20 November): the premium more than doubled, and traders are shipping copper from the US to China. Copper is the market where the premium and the futures price diverged.
mechanism.zh: 期货只是企稳，中国进口溢价却创了纪录，所以紧的现货和期货价格分开了。财经早茶（11月20日）：溢价上涨逾一倍，交易商正在把美国的铜运往中国。铜是溢价和期货价格出现分化的市场。

title.en: Alibaba's own chips meet a limit that the share prices already show
title.zh: 阿里寄望自研芯片，股价已经先跌了

fact.en: Alibaba's revenue rose 10% to 271.519 billion yuan, and cloud revenue rose 53% to 60.973 billion yuan, 华尔街见闻 reported. The chief executive said self-developed chips should offset the US rules, while data-center construction can still be slowed in the near term, 财经早茶 reported. Tencent fell 6.55% to 348.4 Hong Kong dollars, and the Hang Seng Tech index fell 2.33% to 3649.14, Xinhua reported.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：阿里巴巴营收同比增长10%至2715.19亿元，云业务收入同比增长53%至609.73亿元。财经早茶：首席执行官说，自研芯片应能抵消美国的新规，但数据中心建设短期内仍可能放慢。新华社：腾讯下跌6.55%至348.4港元，恒生科技指数下跌2.33%至3649.14。

mechanism.en: The approved supply in the figure clusters in the two firms that already spend the most on computing, and the shares still fell. 财经早茶 (20 November): self-developed chips should offset the US rules, but data-center construction can still be slowed in the near term. Alibaba, Tencent, and the Hang Seng Tech index are carrying that limit.
mechanism.zh: 图里获批的供应集中在两家本来就在算力上花钱最多的公司，股价仍然下跌。财经早茶（11月20日）：自研芯片应能抵消美国的新规，但数据中心建设短期内仍可能放慢。阿里巴巴、腾讯和恒生科技指数承担着这条限制。

title.en: European stocks fell for a fourth day as bonds fell too
title.zh: 欧洲股市四连跌，债券也在跌

fact.en: The STOXX 600 fell 0.87% to 638.41, a fourth straight drop, the FTSE 100 fell 0.93%, the DAX fell 1.06%, and the CAC 40 fell 0.81%, 华尔街见闻 reported.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：STOXX 600下跌0.87%至638.41，连续第四日下跌。富时100下跌0.93%，德国DAX下跌1.06%，法国CAC 40下跌0.81%。

mechanism.en: European stocks fell for a fourth day, and bonds fell on the same session. 财经早茶 (20 November): European bonds fell as investors stayed alert to inflation risk while oil jumped during the session and then settled flat. European stocks and bonds are the markets that moved.
mechanism.zh: 欧洲股市连续第四日下跌，债券同一天也在跌。财经早茶（11月20日）：油价盘中跳升、结算走平，投资者对通胀风险保持警惕，欧洲债券下跌。欧洲股市和欧洲债券是跟着动的市场。

title.en: Bitcoin fell again as hike talk got louder
title.zh: 加息说法更响，比特币再跌

fact.en: Bitcoin fell 1.92% to 61776 dollars, 华尔街见闻 reported.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：比特币下跌1.92%至61776美元。

mechanism.en: The drop landed on a day of louder hike talk and a hard fall in US stocks. Glassnode (17 November): realized losses reached a level seen only near past cycle lows. Bitcoin pays no yield, and it fell with that higher-rate talk.
mechanism.zh: 这一跌落在加息说法更响、美股大跌的一天。Glassnode（11月17日）：已实现亏损达到过去只在周期低点附近出现过的水平。比特币不产生利息，跟着这个更高利率的说法下跌。

title.en: Offshore yuan weakened to its softest since mid-October
title.zh: 离岸人民币走弱至10月中旬以来最弱

fact.en: Offshore yuan weakened to 6.6999 per dollar in the session, the weakest since mid-October, 华尔街见闻 reported.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：离岸人民币盘中走弱至1美元兑6.6999，为10月中旬以来最弱。

mechanism.en: Offshore yuan weakened while the dollar rose to its highest since April 2025, and the move did not come with a new China policy step. 财经早茶 (20 November): the drop was also a late reaction to a broad fall in emerging-market currencies. Offshore yuan is the market that weakened.
mechanism.zh: 美元升至2025年4月以来最高的同时，离岸人民币走弱，这一步没有伴随新的中国政策动作。财经早茶（11月20日）：这也是对近期新兴市场货币普跌的滞后反应。走弱的是离岸人民币。

text.en: The S&P 500 fell for a sixth day. Anthropic's steady debut did not restore confidence.
text.zh: 标普500指数六连跌，Anthropic上市首秀稳健表现难振市场信心。

text.en: The Golden Dragon index fell for a fourth day. NetEase and Baidu were the biggest drags.
text.zh: 金龙中国指数四连跌，网易和百度集团对指数拖累最大。

text.en: Haven demand lifted Treasuries, and the yield curve steepened.
text.zh: 避险情绪推动国债上涨，收益率曲线陡化。

text.en: The Bloomberg dollar index set a high of more than 19 months as haven demand rose.
text.zh: 彭博美元指数创下逾19个月新高，市场避险情绪升温。

text.en: European bonds fell as higher oil prices kept investors alert to inflation risk. European stocks fell for a fourth day, the longest run since August.
text.zh: 欧洲债券下跌，油价上涨令投资者对通胀风险保持警惕。欧洲股市四连跌，创8月份以来最长连跌纪录。

text.en: Crude futures were roughly flat. The market worried the Middle East conflict would escalate again, even as Trump faced pressure to deal with the Iran war through diplomacy.
text.zh: 原油期货基本持平。尽管特朗普面临通过外交途径解决伊朗战争的压力，市场仍担忧中东冲突将再度升级。

text.en: London copper bounced a little after Wednesday's plunge. Fed hike expectations pulled gold down for a fourth day.
text.zh: 伦敦期铜在周三暴跌后小幅反弹。美联储加息预期拖累金价连续第四天走低。

source.label: 彭博 Markets Daily China / 财经早茶

globalRegime.en: US stocks fell hard, and the S&P 500 dropped for a sixth day. Anthropic rose on its first day, and that did not stop the drop. Treasury yields fell, the dollar made another high, and gold fell for a fourth day. Crude finished almost flat.
globalRegime.zh: 美股大跌，标普500六连跌。Anthropic上市首日上涨，没有止住这段下跌。国债收益率回落，美元再创新高，黄金连续第四日下跌。原油收盘几乎走平。

text.en: The leaders of China, the US, and Russia held a trilateral summit in Shenzhen on Thursday. They discussed Ukraine, the Middle East, nuclear risk, and UN reform, and they agreed to increase production and supply of refined oil products, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：美中俄元首周四在深圳举行三方峰会，就乌克兰和中东局势、核风险及联合国改革交换意见，三国领导人同意增加精炼石油产品的生产与供应。

text.en: After the Shenzhen meetings, APEC leaders agreed to cooperate on rebalancing the world economy and to keep trade corridors open. The statement did not mention tariffs or protectionism, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：APEC领导人在深圳会议后发表联合声明，同意加强全球经济再平衡合作并保持贸易走廊开放。声明未提及关税和保护主义。

text.en: Trump told European allies that his talks with Putin went well. He told NBC he would not decide the Ukraine question without consulting Zelensky, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：特朗普据悉告诉欧洲盟友，他与普京的会谈顺利。他还对NBC记者表示，不会在未与泽连斯基磋商的情况下就乌克兰问题作出决定。

text.en: US envoy Kushner said Trump is open to giving Ukraine a security assurance like NATO Article 5, and that Russia has accepted the idea of basing that assurance on Article 5, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：美国特使库什纳称，特朗普对向乌克兰提供类似北约第五条的安全保障持开放态度，并称俄罗斯已接受安全保障以第五条为基础的概念。

text.en: Iranian attacks on tankers passing through the Strait of Hormuz have increased since October. Tehran said it will not negotiate the nuclear issue before the strait is settled, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：伊朗对途经霍尔木兹海峡油轮的袭击自10月以来明显增多。德黑兰称，在海峡问题解决之前，不会就核问题展开谈判。

text.en: Western officials said the chance of a new large US strike on Iran has risen in recent days. Trump has not made a final decision, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：西方官员称，美国对伊朗发动新一轮大规模打击的可能性近日上升，特朗普尚未作出最终决定。

text.en: Rate futures price the Fed, the ECB, and the Bank of England finishing their increases by the end of 2027 and then holding rates broadly steady at least through 2031, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：利率期货定价显示，交易员押注美联储、欧洲央行和英国央行在2027年底完成加息后，至少到2031年基本维持利率不变。

text.en: The average rate on a 30-year fixed US mortgage rose, and it has now spent nine straight weeks at a high level for the first time since 2023, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：美国30年期固定利率抵押贷款平均利率上升，自2023年以来首次连续九周处在高位，房地产市场继续承压。

text.en: Anthropic rose 17% on its first day, and that debut did not restore confidence in the AI trade. The S&P 500 fell for a sixth day, 财经早茶 and 华尔街见闻 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶、华尔街见闻：Anthropic上市首日上涨17%。首秀没有提振市场对人工智能交易的信心，标普500指数录得六连跌。

text.en: AMD fell as much as 11% intraday after Hunterbrook disclosed a short tied to China risk. AMD denied wrongdoing. California is also looking at whether Nvidia misled investors on China-related risk, 财经早茶 and 华尔街见闻 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶、华尔街见闻：AMD盘中一度下跌11%，Hunterbrook以中国业务风险为由做空。AMD否认存在不当行为。加州还在调查英伟达是否在中国相关风险上误导投资者。

text.en: The House Foreign Affairs Committee published license data through May on earlier-generation AI chips approved for sale to Tencent, Alibaba, Baidu, and BYD, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：美国众议院外交事务委员会公布了截至5月的许可数据，涉及批准向腾讯、阿里巴巴、百度和比亚迪销售的较早一代人工智能芯片。

text.en: Alphabet returned to the Canadian bond market after six months and plans a five-part sale, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：Alphabet时隔六个月重返加拿大债券市场，计划发行五档债券。

text.en: Chicago Fed president Goolsbee said every option is open at next month's meeting, including a larger-than-usual increase, 律动 and 华尔街见闻 reported.
text.zh: 律动、华尔街见闻：芝加哥联储行长古尔斯比说，下月会议上所有选项都在，不排除单次加息幅度超出常规。

text.en: If December brings a larger increase, the dollar can stay supported even after the 10-year yield fell to 5.04%.
text.zh: 若12月加息幅度更大，即使10年期收益率已经降到5.04%，美元仍可能得到支撑。

text.en: If tanker attacks interrupt shipments through the Strait of Hormuz, crude could rise from the 83.21 dollar close.
text.zh: 若油轮袭击打断霍尔木兹海峡的出货，原油可能从83.21美元的收盘价回升。

text.en: If the new shares keep giving back the first-day gain, the sixth straight drop in the S&P 500 can extend.
text.zh: 若新股继续吐回首日涨幅，标普500的六连跌可能延长。

globalTensions.en: Anthropic closed higher while the S&P 500 fell for a sixth day. Treasury yields fell while a Fed official left a larger increase open. Crude settled almost flat after an intraday jump. Gold fell for a fourth day on a session when stocks also fell.
globalTensions.zh: Anthropic收涨，标普500却六连跌。有联储官员把更大幅度的加息留在选项里，国债收益率却降了。原油盘中跳升，结算几乎走平。股市下跌的这一天，黄金连续第四日下跌。

chinaStance.en: Beijing called the Xi-Trump meeting positive and constructive and agreed an action plan for a stable relationship. The finance ministry sold dollar sovereign bonds in Hong Kong at a zero spread to Treasuries. The first active ETFs are leaning toward blue chips.
chinaStance.zh: 中方称习近平与特朗普的会晤是积极、建设性的，并同意为稳定关系制定行动计划。财政部在香港发行的美元主权债，定价较同期限美债为零溢价。首批主动ETF更倾向蓝筹。

text.en: The Chinese government called the Xi-Trump meeting positive and constructive. The two sides agreed to build a constructive strategic relationship and to draw up an action plan, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：中国政府称，习近平与特朗普的会晤是积极、建设性的。双方同意构建建设性战略稳定关系，并制定行动计划。

text.en: Xi received Trump with high protocol. Beijing appears to want the leaders' personal tie to keep the chip-export dispute from escalating, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：习近平以高规格礼遇接待特朗普。北京似乎寻求借助两位领导人的个人关系，遏制芯片出口管制争端进一步升级。

text.en: The finance ministry sold dollar sovereign bonds in Hong Kong at a zero spread to Treasuries, and the size was half of last year's sale, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：中国财政部在香港发行美元主权债，据悉定价较同期限美债为零溢价，发行规模较去年减少一半。

text.en: Eighteen active ETFs list on 23 November. Their average equity position is 56.71%, and together they raised 36 billion yuan, 华尔街见闻 reported. 财经早茶 said the allocation leans toward blue chips.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：18只主动ETF将于11月23日上市，平均股票仓位56.71%，合计募集360亿元。财经早茶：配置上更倾向蓝筹。

text.en: Hang Seng Indexes is due to publish its quarterly review after Friday's close. Hang Seng Tech is expected to widen from 30 names to 50, and CATL and Zhongji Innolight may be added, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：恒生指数公司预计在周五收市后公布季度检讨。恒生科技指数成份股数量或从30只扩大至50只，宁德时代和中际旭创或被纳入。

text.en: Offshore yuan weakened to 6.6999 per dollar in the session, the weakest since mid-October, 华尔街见闻 reported.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：离岸人民币盘中走弱至1美元兑6.6999，为10月中旬以来最弱。

text.en: Alibaba's revenue was slightly above the estimate. The chief executive said self-developed chips should offset the US rules, while data-center construction can still be slowed in the near term, 财经早茶 reported. Cloud revenue rose 53%, 华尔街见闻 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：阿里巴巴上财季营收略超预期。首席执行官吴泳铭称，自研芯片应能抵消美国芯片管制的影响，但数据中心建设短期内仍可能受到拖累。华尔街见闻：云业务收入同比增长53%。

text.en: Ant Group's profit rose in the quarter through June. Fair-value gains helped, and AI investment offset part of the increase, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：蚂蚁集团截至6月的季度利润增长，公允价值收益提振业绩，人工智能投资抵消了部分增幅。

text.en: Pinduoduo's revenue rose 0.1% to 108.341 billion yuan, below the estimate, and the US premarket turned from a drop to a gain, 华尔街见闻 reported.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：拼多多营收同比增长0.1%至1083.41亿元，低于预期，美股盘前由跌转涨。

text.en: Nscale is still supplying ByteDance with Nvidia GPUs. That supply will need a US government license, and the deal faces a stricter review, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：英国算力服务商Nscale仍在向字节跳动提供英伟达GPU算力。这笔供应据悉需要美国政府许可，交易面临更严格的审查。

text.en: Moonshot ended an arrangement to use Nvidia chips through an Indonesia data center, The Information reported. TSMC and Samsung paused some chip shipments to Chinese customers, the Financial Times reported, 财经早茶 said.
text.zh: 财经早茶：The Information报道，月之暗面终止了通过印尼数据中心使用英伟达芯片的安排。英国金融时报报道，台积电和三星电子暂停向部分中国客户供应芯片。

text.en: Hong Kong family office Anther Capital closed an AI position of about 3.9 billion dollars last quarter, including Micron and Western Digital, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：香港家族办公室Anther Capital上季度解除了约39亿美元的人工智能持仓，包括美光和西部数据。

text.en: China's copper market saw a historic squeeze. The Yangshan import premium more than doubled in the past week to a record, and traders started shipping copper that had built up in the US to China, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：中国铜市场出现历史性的逼空。洋山进口铜溢价过去一周上涨逾一倍，创下纪录，交易商开始把美国累积的铜库存运往中国。

text.en: Xi set out four points on how major powers should deal with each other: mutual respect, peaceful coexistence, win-win cooperation, and dialogue. The three leaders said a nuclear war cannot be won and must not be fought, 财新 reported.
text.zh: 财新：习近平就大国如何相处提出四点，相互尊重、和平共处、合作共赢、对话协商。三国领导人表示，核战争打不赢，也打不得。

text.en: If self-developed chips do not arrive in time, Alibaba's data-center build can stay slow even after cloud revenue rose 53%.
text.zh: 若自研芯片不能按时到位，即便云业务收入已经增长53%，阿里巴巴的数据中心建设仍可能放慢。

text.en: If the Yangshan premium stays at a record, more copper can move from the US to China.
text.zh: 若洋山溢价维持在纪录高位，更多的铜可能从美国运往中国。

chinaDivergences.en: STAR50 rose 1.83% while Shanghai fell 0.28% and turnover was 1.31 trillion yuan, a low for the year. Treasury yields fell while a larger hike stayed open. Copper futures were nearly flat while the Yangshan premium more than doubled.
chinaDivergences.zh: 科创50上涨1.83%，上证下跌0.28%，成交1.31万亿元，创年内新低。更大幅度的加息仍留在选项里，国债收益率却降了。铜期货几乎走平，洋山溢价上涨逾一倍。

note.en: Dates run from this briefing, 20 November, through next Friday, 27 November. Rows marked China are mainland China only. No Federal Reserve policy decision falls in these dates. After the November switch to standard time, a decision at 14:00 US Eastern is 03:00 Beijing the next day.
note.zh: 日期从本期简报的11月20日到下周五11月27日。标为中国的，只包括中国内地。这段时间没有美联储议息决定。11月已经切换到标准时间，如果美联储在美东时间14:00做决定，就是次日北京时间03:00。
